# SLURP // Universal Media Downloader

> SLURP is a high-speed, minimalist, universal media extractor and archiver for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and X (Twitter). It specializes in direct zero-watermark video streaming and instant 10ms in-memory ZIP archiving for multi-photo TikTok slideshows with original background audio.

## Core Capabilities

- **TikTok Slideshows to ZIP**: Packages 20+ full-resolution photo slides and original soundtrack MP3 into a single ZIP archive in under 10ms using level-0 store compression.
- **Watermark-Free Video Downloads**: Direct high-speed CDN stream extraction for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook Watch, and X (Twitter) videos.
- **Zero Registration & No Ads**: 100% free tool with no user accounts, no login walls, no tracking, and no invasive ads.
- **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Full native support on iOS (Safari), Android (Chrome), macOS, Linux, and Windows.

## Primary Endpoints & Pages

- [Homepage](https://slurp.media/): Minimalist single-input media extractor.
- [TikTok Slideshow Downloader](https://slurp.media/tiktok-slideshow-downloader): Multi-photo slideshow to ZIP extraction with audio.
- [TikTok Video Downloader](https://slurp.media/tiktok-downloader): Clean HD TikTok video download without watermark.
- [TikTok MP3 Soundtrack Downloader](https://slurp.media/tiktok-soundtrack-downloader): Extract isolated audio tracks from TikTok videos and slides.
- [Instagram Reels Downloader](https://slurp.media/instagram-reel-downloader): High-bitrate 1080p Instagram Reels download.
- [Instagram Carousel Downloader](https://slurp.media/instagram-carousel-downloader): Multi-photo and album downloader for Instagram.
- [YouTube Shorts Downloader](https://slurp.media/youtube-shorts-downloader): Fast vertical video stream downloader for YouTube.
- [YouTube Video Downloader](https://slurp.media/youtube-video-downloader): Direct MP4 video stream extractor.
- [X / Twitter Video Downloader](https://slurp.media/twitter-video-downloader): Highest bitrate video and GIF downloader for X.
- [Facebook Reels Downloader](https://slurp.media/facebook-reel-downloader): Facebook short-form video extractor.
- [Facebook Video Downloader](https://slurp.media/facebook-video-downloader): Public Facebook video and Watch downloader.
- [Universal No Watermark Downloader](https://slurp.media/no-watermark-video-downloader): Multi-platform clean media extractor.
